question: What reciprocal relationship does the Goddess have with the guru of the demons?
premises: The Goddess instructs the guru of the demons.
The Goddess is served by the guru of the demons.
inference: The Goddess stands in a reciprocal relationship of teaching and being served with the guru of the demons.
uncertainties: The guru of the demons is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: She is the instructress of the guru of the demons and is served by the guru of the demons.
